title: Yesterday, again
description: More of the past, with the other two verb endings.
grammarNote: The preterite of an -er or -ir verb: comí, comiste, comió, comimos, comisteis, comieron.

items.note: The preterite of pedir. The yo form drops the e: pedí.
The preterite of entender. The yo form drops the e: entendí.
The preterite of llegar. The yo form takes an accent: llegué.
The preterite of salir. The yo form takes an accent: salí.
Masculine: el artículo. It also means an article in a newspaper.
Feminine: la reunión. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la solución. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la decisión. The accent marks the stress.
